answer: Agents stake verifiable credentials in a Verkle tree whose polynomial commitments bind identity proofs to a knoll of historical state roots, so each new Sybil identity must fund a fresh walnut of witness data that pruning cannot amortize across the tundra of archived epochs. Stateless validators then cross-check membership proofs against these commitments, forcing colluders. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
